entries: Whimsy now has a homepage with Settings, keyboard shortcuts, Arc import, feedback, and a Changelog tab.
Mute background tabs and remember muted sites.
Adjust tab volume and video playback speed.
Automatically open picture-in-picture when leaving a video and return it when switching back.
Capture screenshots, edit page text, and allow copy and paste.
Look up unavailable pages in the Internet Archive and inspect image information.
Translate selected text and customize reader typography.
See estimated reading time and optionally darken PDFs.
Find starts with selected text. Update settings appear in About Whimsy.
Move tabs to spaces by dropping them on space icons.
Return to the last selected tab in each space.
Search space emoji and optionally hide the space switcher.
Open links in another space from the context menu.
Customize theme colors with hex values, transparency, menu icons, and the interface font.
Optionally place the New Tab button at the bottom of the sidebar.
Choose folder colors and see a loading progress line.
See unread counts and update dots on pinned tabs and Essentials.
Group tabs by domain.
Copy rich links or links for multiple selected tabs.
Remove tracking parameters and reject cookie banners by default.
Identify private windows and disable browser AI features in Settings.
Duplicate tabs with Cmd+Shift+D and pin or unpin with Cmd+D on macOS.
Open new tabs below the current tab and within its folder.
Customize title wrapping and optionally dim sleeping tabs.
First public release: Arc-style Ctrl+Tab, app icons, interface zoom, your PRs vs your team's, automatic updates
